data.title: NATO jets shoot down drone over Lithuania
data.description: VILNIUS, Lithuania - NATO fighter jets shot down a drone over Lithuania, the Baltic state’s president said Tuesday, in the latest security incident on the alliance’s eastern flank during Russia’s war with Ukraine.

data.title: Ukraine winemakers defy war to make a splash at home
data.description: BEREHOVE — As this year's harvest season entered full swing, a winery in western Ukraine had an additional task to oversee: installing solar panels to help it weather blackouts caused by Russian military strikes.

data.title: Greek neo-Nazi exits prison, vows return to politics
data.description: DOMOKOS — The former spokesman of Greek neo-Nazi party Golden Dawn, Ilias Kasidiaris, was released from prison Tuesday and vowed a return to politics, having already drawn attention from Elon Musk.

data.title: Saudi Arabia vows to respond 'firmly' to Houthi attacks
data.description: SANAA — Saudi Arabia vowed Tuesday to respond "firmly" to attacks by Yemen's Houthis, after the Iran-backed fighters wounded 13 people in the kingdom in an assault using ballistic missiles and drones.

data.title: Beijing imposes total ban on drones after deadly crash
data.description: Beijing has introduced stricter drone regulations, banning all uncrewed flights as well as the possession and storage of existing devices, while detailing disposal methods for the first time in an effort to strengthen security in the capital.

data.title: US military confirms Iran war has led to munitions shortfall
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The United States is facing a shortfall in ammunition as a result of its war against Iran, the Defense Department's inspector general confirmed Monday, contrasting with President Donald Trump's assertions of full stocks.

data.title: Berlin's run-down public spaces at heart of election campaign
data.description: BERLIN — Politicians campaigning for Sunday's Berlin state election have painted an unflattering picture of the German capital, vowing to clear garbage-strewn streets and promising "syringe-free playgrounds".

data.title: Venus may have swallowed its moon
data.description: LOS ANGELES - A California-based astrophysicist presented ​a new theory on Monday to explain why Venus, the ‌planet most like Earth in size, mass and structure, lacks its own moon.

data.title: Beijing puts a total ban on drones in update to regulations after deadly crash
data.description: Beijing has introduced stricter drone regulations, banning all uncrewed flights as well as the possession and storage of existing devices, while detailing disposal methods for the first time in an effort to strengthen security in the capital.

data.title: Number of centenarians in Japan tops 100,000 for 1st time
data.description: KYODO — The number of people aged 100 or older in Japan reached a record high of 107,677 in September, climbing for the 56th consecutive year, health ministry data showed Tuesday.

data.title: Drone shot down by Nato over Lithuania
data.description: VILNIUS - North Atlantic Treaty Organisation (Nato) fighter jets shot down a drone over Lithuania, the Baltic state's president said Tuesday, in the latest security incident on the alliance's eastern flank during Russia's war with Ukraine.

data.title: US Supreme Court blocks Trump mail-in ballot restrictions
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The US Supreme Court dealt a major blow Monday to President Donald Trump's attempts to restrict mail-in voting before the November midterm elections, denying his request to lift an order halting the divisive plan.

data.title: New Zealand agencies missed red flags in child kidnapping case: inquiry
data.description: WELLINGTON - New Zealand authorities failed to act on prior warnings that a man who went on the run with his kids for four years had a stash of guns and fears he would kidnap his children, an inquiry into a case that drew global headlines found Tuesday.

data.title: Alarm over AI grows as divided US Congress struggles to act
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The US Congress returned from recess Monday facing urgent warnings that artificial intelligence could spin dangerously out of control -- and little agreement over whether, or how, Washington should intervene.

data.title: Trump says Ukraine, Russia agree not to hit energy targets
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump said Monday that Ukraine and Russia had agreed not to target each other's energy facilities, a day after he chastised Kyiv for hitting Russian oil refineries.

data.title: Trump blasts 'sick conspiracy' against AI as warnings mount
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump on Monday attacked what he called a "sick conspiracy" against artificial intelligence, dismissing calls for guardrails despite warnings that it threatens humankind.

data.title: Russia intensifies attacks seeking to intimidate Ukraine, Europe
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Russia has in recent weeks intensified attacks against civilian targets in Ukraine, seeking to drain Ukrainian morale and intimidate Kyiv's European allies at a time when Moscow believes it has the advantage in weapons production, analysts say.

data.title: Trump moves to axe power plant climate rules
data.description: HOUSTON - President Donald Trump's administration is expected Monday to scrap limits on carbon emissions from fossil fuel-fired power plants, the source of nearly a quarter of the country's climate pollution.

data.title: Canada makes pitch as safe place to invest in 'uncertain world'
data.description: TORONTO (CANADA) - Canada is a safe place to invest "in a very uncertain world," Finance Minister Francois-Philippe Champagne told AFP Monday, ahead of a summit where the country is seeking an unprecedented influx of private-sector investment.

data.title: More than 120 unaccounted for after ferry sinks in Indonesia
data.description: JAKARTA — Rescue teams in Indonesia were searching Monday for 129 people who were unaccounted for after a passenger ferry sank in the Java Sea, killing at least six people, the authorities said.

data.title: Houthis target Saudi base as Iran denies involvement in Yemen war
data.description: SANAA - Yemen's Houthis launched a fresh barrage of missile and drone attacks on Saudi military targets on Monday, as Iran denied any involvement in the country's revived civil war.

data.title: Sweden faces political uncertainty after election thriller
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Sweden faced political uncertainty on Monday, after an election thriller that saw the leftwing opposition holding a slim lead with votes still left to count.

data.title: Surfer hospitalised after shark attack in Western Australia
data.description: SYDNEY — A surfer in his fifties was rushed to hospital on Monday after being bitten by a shark in Western Australia, the state government and local ambulance service said.

data.title: Hong Kongers hit with unauthorised charges for new iPhone as banks launch probes
data.description: Scores of Hong Kongers have complained about unauthorised transactions on credit cards used to pre-order Apple's latest iPhones, prompting major banks to launch investigations.

data.title: Okinawa voters elect pro-US base governor
data.description: TOKYO - A candidate backed by Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's ruling party won a gubernatorial election in Okinawa, bringing to power a leader who approves of a contentious US military base relocation plan for the first time in 12 years.

data.title: US hosts G20 'energy abundance' talks amid Iran war shock
data.description: HOUSTON, Texas - The United States on Monday kicks off a set of G20 meetings touting "energy abundance," even as President Donald Trump's war against Iran continues to disrupt global fuel markets.

data.title: South Korea aims to save seniors lost in digital age
data.description: SUWON (SOUTH KOREA) - A little cheer rose for 79-year-old Hwang Sun-hee after she managed to place an online order at a training session in South Korea, which has one of the world's starkest digital divides for seniors.
